This Criminal Petition, Coming On For Admission,
This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

Petitioner is before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.9763/2017 (Crime No.132 of 2016) registered for the offences punishable under Sections 506, 498A and 34 of the IPC pending before the XXXVII ACMM Court, Bengaluru.

During the pendency of the petition, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute amicably amongst themselves and have decided to live together and in that light have filed an application under Section 320(1) and (8) r/w Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeking compounding of the offences.

The application reads as follows:
".... .... ....

sentences.text: That now the Respondent No.2/original complainant on advice of elders of her family members and well-wishers has amicably settled the disputes with the petitioner herein.
It is submitted that in view of the settlement arrayed between the parties the complainant withdraws her allegations against the petitioner.
Further, the complainant does not intend to proceed against the petitioner in the above case.
That the settlement arrived between parties is voluntary and without any undue influence.

Under these circumstances this Hon'ble High Court may be pleased to permit the petitioner and respondent No.2/complainant to compound the case by quashing the criminal proceedings against the petitioner.

IT IS THEREFORE prayed that this Hon'ble High Court may be pleased to permit the Petitioner and the Respondent No.2/Complaint to compound the offence and be pleased to quash the criminal proceedings against the petitioner in C.C.No.9763/2017 pending on the file XXXVII ACMM Court,
Bengaluru (charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Section 498(A), 506 r/w 34 IPC) in the interest of justice."
NC: 2023:KHC:20046 3.

In the light of the compromise arrived at between the parties as aforesaid and the offences being the one punishable under Section 498A of the IPC, which is not against the State or Society, I deem it appropriate to obliterate the proceedings pending against the petitioner.

4. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER (i) Criminal Petition is disposed.

(ii) Impugned proceedings in C.C.No.9763/2017 pending before the XXXVII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Bengaluru stands quashed qua the petitioner.
Sd/-
